selection_rule.summary: One archetype per item_id. No batch repeats one template. The design handoff picks an archetype per item_id that balances both experiment cells (control/variant) so no cell is starved of a template family.
rules: Every item_id gets exactly one Shorts archetype and one Threads/social archetype.
No template is used twice within one batch (template_id must be unique per platform within the batch).
The handoff alternates/round-robins archetypes across item_ids and balances the archetype mix between the control and variant cells of the active experiment.
Legacy templates (scenario-b, scenario-c, harness-architecture) stay registered and usable; they are never removed or renamed.
A new archetype may only be registered with an existing, parseable HTML template and a documented research mapping (research_brief section).
